description: This file contains shell functions and variables used for building, testing, and managing Go (Golang) binaries within the Kubernetes project. It includes platform setup, build configuration, and coverage instrumentation functions specific to the Kubernetes build process.

methods.name: kube::golang::setup_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables for Go build, including GOPATH, GOCACHE, GOMODCACHE, and PATH, and verifies Go version.

methods.name: kube::golang::build_binaries
methods.description: Builds all Kubernetes binaries for specified targets and platforms, possibly in parallel based on system memory.

methods.name: kube::golang::build_binaries_for_platform
methods.description: Builds binaries for a specific platform, handling static/dynamic linking and test binaries.

methods.name: kube::golang::is_statically_linked
methods.description: Determines if a binary should be built with static linking based on overrides and platform.

methods.name: kube::golang::best_guess_go_targets
methods.description: Converts a list of build target names or paths into the best guess of Go package names.

methods.name: kube::golang::normalize_go_targets
methods.description: Normalizes build targets into Go package names, handling test and vendor paths.

methods.name: kube::golang::host_platform
methods.description: Returns the host platform as a string, e.g., 'linux/amd64'.

methods.name: kube::golang::set_platform_envs
methods.description: Sets environment variables GOOS, GOARCH, and possibly CC and CGO_ENABLED for cross-compilation.

methods.name: kube::golang::internal::verify_go_version
methods.description: Verifies that the Go toolchain is installed and meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: kube::golang::path_for_coverage_dummy_test
methods.description: Returns the file path for a dummy coverage test for a given package.

methods.name: kube::golang::create_coverage_dummy_test
methods.description: Creates a dummy test file in the source directory for coverage instrumentation.

methods.name: kube::golang::delete_coverage_dummy_test
methods.description: Removes the dummy coverage test file for a package.

methods.name: kube::golang::build_some_binaries
methods.description: Builds specified packages, handling coverage instrumentation if enabled.

methods.name: kube::golang::get_physmem
methods.description: Returns the approximate physical memory in gigabytes.
